newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA NET AVERAGE WAGE 9.7 PCT UP IN OCTOBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA NET AVERAGE WAGE 9.7 PCT UP IN OCTOBER.

text.p: The average net wage in
Romania rose by 9.7 percent in October from September, an
increase well above 3.4 percent monthly inflation, National
Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Friday.
The CNS said the rise was an effect of wage indexations,
compensation to wages for electricity and fuel price rises and
bonuses given last month.
Data showed Romanians' purchasing power went up by 6.1
percent in October from the previous month and by 6.4 percent
year-on-year. October's purchasing power was 24.7 percent down
on the 1990 level.
Employees in the banking sector had the highest net wage of
799,155 lei on average in October, when workers in the health
and social security sectors had the lowest pay -- 274,597 lei.
Romania employed 5.76 million people at end-October, 40,000
less than the previous month.
